title: 19K ⭐ AI Agents With Types, Not Just Chat
description:
Pydantic AI is an open source Python tool for building AI agents with outputs that can be validated against a data type. You can swap models, from OpenAI to local models, without rewriting the agent logic.

https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai

This video is a discovery based on the public GitHub page and documentation, not a hands-on test.
The link is in the description.
